summary: This topic covers the process of creating, viewing, and editing items within the inventory module. It explains how to define item codes, assign items to groups, and manage item group hierarchies. Users can also create new item groups on the fly if needed.
steps: To create a new item: Navigate to Inventory > Masters > Items, then click 'Create'.
Select an existing Item Group (e.g., Stationary Data, Instrument).
If the desired Item Group does not exist, click the icon to create a new one.
When creating an Item Group, specify if it's 'Primary' (top-level) or a sub-group under an existing group (e.g., 'Pens' under 'Stationary Data').
To view or edit an existing item: Navigate to Inventory > Masters > Items, then click 'Edit'. Search for the item and make necessary modifications.
business_rules: The Item Code field is non-mandatory.
Item groups can be organized hierarchically (e.g., 'Ball Pens' under 'Pens', and 'Pens' under 'Stationary Data').
important_notes: The system allows users to create new item groups directly from the item creation interface if they are not already present.
